THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0: The final boss has appeared! Aris, moving out!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.1: This is the Magic of Courage!
DARV.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-0.ancien: Welcome, little miss! Looking for something?
DARV.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.char: Aris knows what this is. A secret shop!
DARV.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.1-0r.ancie: Before ya set off on your adventure, take one of these with ya!
DARV.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-0.ancien: Look who it is, little miss! How've ya been?
DARV.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1.char: Aris is gathering companions to defeat the Demon King!
DARV.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-2.ancien: They ain't companions, but I've got plenty of good wares. Have a look before ya go.
NEOW.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.char: The adventure begins! Where is the starting equipment?
NEOW.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.1-0r.char: [sine]O brave hero, how pitiful to be defeated~[/sine]
NEOW.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1r.char: A save point! What bonus does today's run offer?
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-0.a: The road ahead is perilous. Don my blessing and reach the summit.
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.c: A new blessing! Aris can feel her power growing.
I have finer clothes and treasures for you. Don't be shy; choose one.
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-0.a: You've returned. I have beautiful garments prepared for you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1.c: Will these clothes fit Aris's class too?
OROBAS.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-0.anci: Equipment! Huge! How carry it around??
OROBAS.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1.char: Aris thinks so too. Is there no way to avoid fighting?
PAEL.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.char: Rest is important. It restores HP.
PAEL.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.1-0r.ancie: [thinky_dots]Friend, my flesh will aid you on your adventure...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1.ancien: [thinky_dots]Sleep is important... If you'd like, lie down here for a while...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.char: This is the Sword of Light, Super Nova. A hero's weapon!
TANX.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-2.ancien: THAT IS A SWORD?! EVEN MORE AMAZING!!
TANX.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.1-0r.ancie: TAKE A WEAPON! THE MORE THE BETTER!!
TANX.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-2.ancien: YOU FIGHT EVEN BETTER THAN I EXPECTED!! TAKE A WEAPON!
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-0.a: I've never seen you before, child. Would you tell me why you've come?
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.c: Aris is on the main quest: an adventure to defeat the Demon King at the summit!
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.a: What a cute goal. Come here, dear. Let me kindle your little [jitter][b]flame[/b][/jitter] a bit brighter.
Sit here, dear, and have some [jitter][b]cookies[/b][/jitter].
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-0.a: Welcome back, dear. Has everything been well?
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1.c: Aris is still adventuring! Aris keeps challenging the final boss!
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-2.a: I'm glad to hear it. Take some [jitter][b]treats[/b][/jitter] for the road.
VAKUU.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-1.ancie: Hey, I'm not some Demon King.
VAKUU.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.0-2.char: Ah! Sorry. Aris mistook you for a monster!
VAKUU.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.1-0r.anci: I sense something hidden within you... The power of a [sine]god from another world[/sine]?
VAKUU.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-0.ancie: Choose the [sine]contract[/sine] you desire. Receive power for a modest price.
VAKUU.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-1.char:
So-called [jitter]cursed equipment[/jitter]!
Could there be a Remove Curse scroll somewhere in this dungeon?
VAKUU.talk.STS2ARIS-ST_S2_ARIS.2-2.ancie: Contracts are not so easily broken.
